purpose: ELF3 kinematic proxy for Stage-1 planner; NOT native KiMoDo-SOMA calibration

coordinate_transform.elf3_frame: Z up, +X forwards, +Y left (inferred from symmetric right/left shoulder frames)
coordinate_transform.planner_frame: Y up, +Z forwards, +X left (right arm is at negative X)
coordinate_transform.quaternion_convention: The planner and robot coordinate axes are rotated bases; orientations need R_planner=M R_elf M^T

references.virtual_pelvis_definition: midpoint of l_hip_y_link and r_hip_y_link origins at zero joint angles
references.neutral_configuration: all URDF joint coordinates equal zero; NOT verified to be natural standing pose

assumptions_not_derived_from_urdf.pelvis_height_m: Set equal to hip-to-ankle separation at URDF q=0, with ankle center at z=0. NOT sole-ground height or measured standing height.
assumptions_not_derived_from_urdf.neutral_wrist_local_m: Zero-joint FK result; not an ergonomically validated neutral configuration.
assumptions_not_derived_from_urdf.comfort_center_local_m: One joint-limit-valid FK seed with shoulder_y=-0.55, wrist_y=+0.55 radians, preserving global wrist orientation; not an optimized comfortable pose.
assumptions_not_derived_from_urdf.comfort_half_widths_m: Retained from original MPC settings. This box is NOT an inverse-kinematic feasible-set certificate.
assumptions_not_derived_from_urdf.wrist_to_tip_local_m: Retained provisional original value: the two URDFs contain NO wrist-to-tip joint/frame; mesh geometries were NOT supplied.
assumptions_not_derived_from_urdf.fixed_wrist_orientation_xyzw: Identity from the zero-joint / compensated-reach reference; true handshake orientation remains to be calibrated.
assumptions_not_derived_from_urdf.max_pelvis_wrist_distance_m: Retained original hard radius; smaller than the nominal fixed-torso geometric upper bound, but is NOT sufficient for reachability.
assumptions_not_derived_from_urdf.motion_limits: Retained MPC speed/acceleration limits; URDF revolute effort/velocity limits cannot determine task-space locomotion/acceleration bounds.

limits_of_use: ELF3 and SOMA skeletal geometries are not interchangeable; use this as approximate planning geometry only.
The URDF files use meshes/hand models that are not included; no contact surface, finger tip or foot sole can be measured.
Only nominal rigid fixed-waist link geometry is used; true whole-body IK, contact feasibility and motion generation remain unverified.
Stage 1 holds heading and wrist orientation fixed; retargeted motion may need different constraints.
The torso is defined as torso_link, whereas the pelvis is a virtual hip midpoint. Do not substitute the torso for KiMoDo Hips.
urdf_comparison: Identical joints, limits, axes and link transformations; differ only in visual/collision wrist mesh paths.
